Name: Vikram Sehgal
Bio:
Vikram Sehgal is a Founder of Plaksha. He is a Co-founder and responsible for managing Nagarro's global operations. Under his stewardship, the company's operations have steadily grown in personnel, infrastructure and capabilities. Vikram has extensive experience in large-scale project management, resource and capacity management, establishing quality processes and fast ramp-ups. He has been overseeing implementations in several domains including SCADA systems, regulatory pharmaceuticals, product engineering and manufacturing optimization. Vikram has more than 19 years of IT industry experience. He is a gold medalist in Electronics and Communications Engineering from REC Kurukshetra.

"A great company is one that remains intolerant of mediocrity even as it scales."
